rows.notes: The document is explicitly labelled a Review Article and the acknowledgement calls it a review paper. It contains no own experiment, survey, measurements or model runs; it compiles general descriptions of drip system types, components, advantages/disadvantages and literature statements (e.g., 30-70% water saving vs sprinkler, reduced evaporation) without any original data. The conclusion refers to yield, WUE and benefit-cost results that are not reported anywhere in the text and appear to be borrowed from cited work. Hence Q1 is no and all other questions are no.
